title: Screen two CATPart folders
description: Only .CATPart files are processed. GE files are detected from filename separators and SIN/PN identifiers.
runPrompt: Select folders A and B, then start screening.
noCatparts: No CATPart files were found in at least one folder.
limit: Up to 20,000 CATPart files per folder.
matchesTitle: GE files with a shared SIN
matchesDescription: These files share a SIN, but none of their PNs match between A and B.
sameGeDescription: These groups share the same GE identifier in both folders; filenames or suffixes may differ.
noMatches: No GE files with a shared SIN and different PNs.
noSameGe: No GE files with the same SIN and PN in both folders.
